core_obligations: Preserve computability, honesty, approximation-gap and advantage conditions.
Retain complete profile-oracle replacement and all three AM protocol cases.
Keep the reverse generator reduction and constant-query variant together with the main dichotomy, without splitting supporting results.
difficulty_reason: The authors replace the Kolmogorov oracle by perturbed query-probability profiles on compressible counterexamples. Entropy estimation and preimage-size protocols verify the profile; a three-case analysis handles underestimation, overestimation and stable rounding. The exact logarithmic boundary is paired with the author generator reduction.
